notes: Technical report on Ling 2.0 (Ling-mini-2.0, Ling-flash-2.0, Ling-1T). No dedicated safety, alignment-safety, or dangerous-capability section. 'Alignment' tables are Arena Hard / Writing Bench / Creative Writing / Multi-Challenge (chat preference); skipped per pilot safety-only rule along with math, coding, reasoning, knowledge, IFEval, BFCL. 'training safety' / FP8 safeguard text is numerical training stability, not model safety. Date Oct 24, 2025 is the report date, not an explicit model release date. No external safety testers. Covered seed model inclusionAI/Ling-1T; report also describes Ling-mini-2.0 and Ling-flash-2.0 (seed checkpoints of that model).
